source: Hydrous Mineral Detections (OMEGA, CRISM), distributed by NASA Mars Trek
reference: Carter, J., Poulet, F., Bibring, J.-P., Mangold, N., Murchie, S. (2013), Hydrous minerals on Mars as seen by the CRISM and OMEGA imaging spectrometers: Updated global view, JGR Planets 118, 831-858.
limitations: Point locations of detections only; the distributed file does not carry the mineral class of each detection. Absence of a point is not evidence of absence (coverage is targeted).
